environment: Disposable PostgreSQL 16.9 container, no host ports, no production data. Linux Go 1.26.8 CGO_ENABLED=0; existing local-only schema-isolated repository helper. Container stopped/removed after tests.

findings: Actual missing schema: reports source/evidence columns and music_sessions absent from PostgreSQL migrations.

Initial untriaged failures included cascade cleanup, retired-application token SQL and group timestamp handling. Follow-up traced cascade SQLite opens and trigger-drop syntax to SQLite-specific test fixtures, not production transaction routing.

Several tests contain SQLite-only PRAGMA, trigger, sqlite_master, FTS and text timestamp assumptions; broad cross-dialect acceptance is not established. Do not remove these tests to claim PostgreSQL support.

fix: Additive PostgreSQL migration 018 adds report context/evidence, music session persistence and built-in music bot identity parity.
remaining: Triaging and fixing remaining PostgreSQL runtime failures and dialect-specific test fixtures.
Production PostgreSQL opener explicitly requires version 18; this 16.9 compatibility test is not version-18 acceptance.
Existing-database upgrade, backup/restore and rollback verification; full regression after remediation.

postgres18_followup.runtime_fix: Group message deletion compares persisted timestamp/ID ordering directly rather than COALESCE(timestamp,''); this avoids invalid PostgreSQL timestamps and driver serialization differences, and accounts for equal timestamp ordering.
postgres18_followup.fixture_fixes: Foreign-key-disabled fixture connections select PostgreSQL for PostgreSQL DSNs, with localhost and hichat_test_ search_path guards. Explicit cleanup still runs with FK/trigger enforcement disabled in isolated tests; production enforcement unchanged. Retired token legacy-row fixture uses DROP TRIGGER ... ON bot_tokens on PostgreSQL.
passed: PostgreSQL 18: GroupDMRepository, GroupDMDelete, report context persistence and music session round trip (7.176s).
PostgreSQL 18: retired application token validation, server cascade removes, entrance-channel cleanup and group delete counts (8.574s).
SQLite: retired application tokens, server cascade removes, entrance-channel cleanup and all GroupDM cases (1.772s).
New unread-count test covers deletion before the read marker, deletion of the marker and deletion of an unread message sharing the same timestamp.
postgres18_followup.isolation: PostgreSQL 18 container exposed no host ports and was stopped/removed after tests. No production data or security settings changed.
postgres18_followup.limits: Only targeted PostgreSQL 18 coverage; full repository regression and upgrade/rollback acceptance remain open.

acceptance: Not accepted. No production cutover or release.
